newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh police arrest suspected Indian rebels.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh police arrest suspected Indian rebels.

text.p: Bangladesh police said on Wednesday they had arrested two suspected Indian Naga rebels in Dhaka.
Police said they caught the two men from India's insurgency-ridden northeastern state of Nagaland, which borders Bangladesh, on Monday and recovered two revolvers from them.
The Naga youths, identified by police as Sang Yu Jamir, 20, and Sony (one name), 21, are being interrogated by police.
Bangladesh and India agreed last week to cooperate in fighting insurgency along their borders. Separatist Maoists from the Naga tribe have been fighting Indian authorities for decades.
